n = int(input())
k = int(input())
p = int(input())

def bitcount(x):
    return bin(x).count('1')

def fw_transform(a, n, p, inv):
    length = 1
    while length < n:
        for i in range(0, n, length << 1):
            for j in range(length):
                u = a[i + j]
                v = a[i + j + length]
                if not inv:
                    a[i + j] = (u + v) % p
                else:
                    a[i + j] = (u - v + p) % p
        length <<= 1

def pow_conv(a, k, p):
    n = len(a)
    if k == 1:
        return a
    if k % 2 == 1:
        temp = pow_conv(a, k - 1, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + temp[i] * a[j]) % p
        return res
    else:
        half = pow_conv(a, k // 2, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + half[i] * half[j]) % p
        return res

def subset_power(a, k, p):
    size = 1
    while size < len(a):
        size <<= 1
    fa = [[0] * size for _ in range(20)]
    fc = [[0] * size for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(20):
        for j in range(len(a)):
            fa[i][j] = a[j] if j < len(a) else 0
        fw_transform(fa[i], size, p, False)
    for i in range(size):
        v = [fa[j][i] for j in range(20)]
        v = pow_conv(v, k, p)
        for j in range(20):
            fc[j][i] = v[j]
    for i in range(20):
        fw_transform(fc[i], size, p, True)
    res = [0] * size
    for j in range(size):
        c = bitcount(j)
        if c < 20 and j < len(a):
            res[j] = fc[c][j]
    return res

MAXN = 10**6 + 5
fac = [1] * MAXN
invFac = [1] * MAXN

maskVal = 0
for i in range(20):
    if (n >> i) & 1:
        maskVal |= (1 << i)

f = [0] * (maskVal + 1)
for i in range(maskVal + 1):
    t = 0
    for j in range(20):
        if (n >> j) & 1:
            t <<= 1
            t |= (i >> j) & 1
    f[t] = i

if n & 1:
    print(pow(k, n, p))
    exit()

for i in range(1, MAXN):
    fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % p

invFac[MAXN - 1] = pow(fac[MAXN - 1], p - 2, p)
for i in range(MAXN - 2, -1, -1):
    invFac[i] = (invFac[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p

a = [0] * (maskVal + 1)
for i in range(maskVal + 1):
    a[i] = invFac[f[i]]

res = pow(k, n, p)
a = subset_power(a, k, p)
subtractVal = (a[maskVal] * fac[n]) % p
res = (res - subtractVal + p) % p
print(res)
